notes.title: Void Scout Update – v1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: [p]This is a quick hotfix for a bug that affected French players only.[/p][p]The bug resulted in a lot of missing text in the game.[/p][p]It should now show the English-version language correctly (sorry there is no actual French-language version currently.)[/p]

notes.title: Void Scout Update – v1.2 - More enemy variety, more tactical freedom and options
notes.notes: [p]The latest update is here, bringing more variety and more ways to fight for survival.[/p][list][*][p][b]Enemies evolve[/b]: vulnerabilities, resistances, and new special skills mean no two fights are the same, and enemies are harder to control and bottleneck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee matters[/b]: melee weapons hit harder and stun more often, making close combat a stronger option.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical freedom[/b]: nanotech powers are now all bonus actions, so you can strike [i]and[/i] unleash abilities in the same turn. You can also move [i]after[/i] attacking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New powers[/b]: fresh nanotech skills to discover, from the devastating [i]Fury[/i] to the defensive [i]Hardening[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p]The multiverse grows more dangerous, but so too do your options. Adapt, improvise, and survive.[/p][p][/p][p]The full change list is below. Let me know what you think of the update! Whether you love it or hate it, feedback is welcome.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ Combat & Weapons[/h2][list][*][p]Player’s punch attack base damage increased to [b]2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Disposable weapons[/b] now deal [b]+1 damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sledgehammer, shovel, crowbar, and baseball bat[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shockrod[/b] stun duration increased ([b]1 → 2 turns[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flamer, Blaze, Railgun, and Zeus[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 Nanotech Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rupture, Flare, and Rush[/b] nanotech skills now [b]stun[/b] targets. [b]Flashbang[/b] cooldown increased ([b]4 → 5[/b]) and [b]Flare[/b] cooldown increased ([b]3 → 4[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rupture, Flare, Grenade, and Flashbang[/b] nanotech are now [b]bonus abilities[/b] (can be used in addition to attacking).[/p][/*][*][p]If unused nanotech bonus powers remain, you may now trigger them at the [b]end of your turn[/b] after moving/attacking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Armor Skin[/b] buffed ([b]5/8/10 → 10/15/20[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Might[/b] buffed ([b]1/2/3 → 2/3/4[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stealth[/b] buffed ([b].15/.25/.35 → .25/.4/.5[/b]). This means enemies lose you faster and less enemies appear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardening (Passive):[/b] This [b]new nanotech[/b] reduces all damage taken after the first hit each turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scanner (Passive):[/b] Reveals hidden information on the mini-map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nanorend (Active):[/b] Deals damage to all spaces around the Void Scout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fury (Active):[/b] Make an additional attack with a carried weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]nanopairs[/b] added for these new nanotechs, with potential for eternal growth through level-ups.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Player Turn Flow[/h2][list][*][p]You can now [b]attack before moving[/b] (movement points are no longer lost when attacking).[/p][/*][*][p]After completing movement/attacking, you will now get a [b]final chance to use any bonus actions[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Enemies[/h2][list][*][p]Some enemies now have a [b]vulnerability[/b]: attacks with the right damage type deal extra damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies with vulnerabilities gain extra base HP: [b]+2 (small enemies), +5 (chonkers)[/b] - make sure to use those vulnerabilities![/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss and Chonker enemies[/b] now have [b]stacking Stable[/b] (ignore one stun attempt each turn before being affected).[/p][/*][*][p][b]All enemies[/b] gain [b]1 turn of Stable[/b] after being stunned – preventing easy stun-locking.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain enemy types now have inherent [b]special skills[/b] (not as often as bosses).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now show their [b]special skill usage[/b] in log messages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More enemies[/b] now spawn in all sectors to balance the player’s increased firepower.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💥 Environment[/h2][list][*][p]Many more [b]destructible and explosive objects[/b] added to sectors for more dynamic battlefields.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Electric barrels[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b] to adjacent enemies, other explosive objects now carry [b]elemental damage types[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📖 UI & Guide[/h2][list][*][p]New [b]in-game guide page[/b] explaining damage types, Stun, and Stable mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]tutorial message[/b] explaining movement after attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspecting analysed non-boss enemies now shows their [b]skills[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Boss health bar now displays [b]revealed skills[/b] (inherent or already used).[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars also now show the [b]Stun/Stable[/b] level of an enemy.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some [b]nanopairs[/b] had incorrect passive nanotech values.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226540/Void_Scout/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]👥 Join the Community[/h1][p]We’d love to have you with us as the multiverse notes.title: Void Scout Update 1.1.1 – Tutorial skip option, Steam Deck support, and more
notes.notes: [p]A new patch has just been deployed with quality-of-life improvements, control tweaks, and a few small balance changes. Here's what’s new in version [b]1.1.1[/b]:[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 [b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Skip Tutorial Option[/b]: You can now disable the tutorial for new games once you've completed the tutorial once. (It’ll apply retroactively if you already have!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Enhancements[/b]: Improved resolution settings and a new default control scheme. [i](To use it, you may need to revert to default in your Deck's controller settings.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse Wheel Support[/b]: Scroll between your weapons using the mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attack Nanotech[/b]: You can now select attack nanotech like [i]Flare[/i] or [i]Flashbang[/i] during movement. (Using one still ends your move.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚖️ [b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Mission 3 – Unearthed Secrets[/b]: In the final battle, the exoartifact health is reduced slightly (from 50 → 40) to improve pacing and balance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where players could get stuck if defeated during the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam user icon now displays right-side-up. (Sorry about that!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone playing and sharing feedback - more improvements are coming![/p][p][/p][p]Feedback on the Steam Deck control layout would be welcome![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226540"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]👥 Join the Community[/h1][p]We’d love to have you with us as the multiverse collapses:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FrQa9nZJBw3"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fvoidscout.bsky.social"]Follow on Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fvoidscoutgame"]Follow on X[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fvoidscout"]Follow on Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Void Scout Update 1.1 – Steam Achievements, Cloud Saves & More!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Void Scouts![/p][p]I’ve just pushed out a new update for [i]Void Scout[/i], and I’m excited to share what’s new:[/p][h3]✨ What’s New[/h3][p][b]🧠 Steam Achievements – Now Live[/b]
There are [b]44 achievements[/b] to discover, including versions for [i]Ironscout[/i] players who brave the permanent death experience. Progress achievements will retroactively unlock the next time you load the game.[/p][p][b]☁️ Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
Steam Cloud support has been added! Your save file will now be automatically set up for cloud syncing.
Just open the game once, and Steam will take care of the rest when you exit.[/p][p][b]🔕 HP Alert Ping – Toggle Option[/b]
A new option has been added by request to the audio settings to disable the HP warning ping, for those who don't want to hear that they're low on health.[/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate all the support so far, it means the world, especially as a solo developer![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226540/Void_Scout/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]👥 Join the Community[/h1][p]We’d love to have you with us as the multiverse collapses:[/p][list][*][p] [url="https://discord.gg/rQa9nZJBw3"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/voidscout.bsky.social"]Follow on Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://x.com/voidscoutgame"]Follow on X[/url][/p][/*][*][p] [url="https://www.facebook.com/voidscout"]Follow on Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list]
